in_sanskrit.name: Sofikul
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Wise, Clever
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sofikul एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Sofikul is a combination of two Sanskrit words - 'Sofi' meaning wisdom and 'Kul' meaning family or clan. This name signifies a wise and clever leader who is respected in his community.
